design.description: One ordinary sixteen-coefficient AVX512F path replaces two-half widened arithmetic and output reassembly. Preserve Q17 sign/threshold/level-cap/matrix arithmetic, direct signed narrowing, RFC6386-derived diagonal order, unchanged AVX2/scalar fallbacks and exact packets. No operand arrays, prepared-mode grouping, cache, pool, API or owner.

pairedComparison.scope: Complete frozen 513x259 opaque photographic RGBA8 encode, Q75/effort4; incremental managed-build elapsed comparison, not FFmpeg parity or an alpha CPU-gain claim.
pairedComparison.boundary: Twelve fixed adjacent original/candidate pairs, alternating order, complete public RGBA8 WebP encodes per subject, fixed operation count recorded per pair, all pairs retained without filtering. Each isolated immutable assembly owns an identical resident source. Setup/JIT/validation excluded; fresh MemoryStream construction/growth, complete encode, independent output and disposal included. Scoped managed-build comparison resolves native-bracket clock uncertainty, not new FFmpeg costs or parity proof.

photograph.boundary: One frozen resident 513x259 opaque RGBA8 photograph or text/diagram to complete owned WebP. Public managed EncodeWebp/admission, source processing, fresh MemoryStream growth/disposal included, no redundant ToArray. Native normalization/repacking, pixel import/encoding and independent packet ownership included. Wrappers/private scratch reused; every pixel reprocessed, no packet cache. Font/image preparation, I/O, IPC, validation and startup excluded. One CPU; effort4, frozen reference quality75. Complete packets exact; VP8L source pixels exact, VP8 identical reconstructed pixels, exact alpha. Quality numbers are not the matching criterion.

alpha.boundary: Resident original RGBA8 to complete independent VP8 WebP bytes with exact normalized alpha. Full source normalization and repacking included. Native codec/scratch/frame/packet wrappers reused; RGBA-to-BGRA repacking and complete encode execute every operation. Fresh managed MemoryStream creation, growth, encode and disposal included; no redundant ToArray. Both effort settings fixed at 4; managed coefficient modeling follows the identified producer's geometry, memory and cancellation eligibility; native adaptive coding declared. Alpha-weighted RGB source-error matching before composite rounding, Complete native packet equality at frozen quality75/method4 is required; matched-packet reconstruction is a sanity check, including hidden RGB. Fresh geometry/decoder/alpha/source/ownership/bitstream checks before/after. Startup, IPC, I/O, fixture generation, quality enumeration and checks excluded.

qualification.existingActualKernelCoverage: Whole coefficient/int32 domain, matrix rounding/sign/threshold, native fragment agreement, tails/canaries and zero per-block allocation; all existing exact public packets. No test-only implementation or mirrored test added.

uncertainty: The photographic short raw point improves12.20% against older valid evidence while its native bracket is7.64% faster; that is not an attributable gain. One early counterbalanced immutable-build comparison confirms5.43%/733.52us scoped elapsed reduction. Alpha short is nearly flat; no alpha incremental CPU claim. All eight current FFmpeg comparisons are gaps. No additional causal gain claim follows the cost refresh. All actuals, adverse points and both confidence views remain.
corrections: A stale copied Windows baseline precondition stops before compilation; use the verified original snapshot hash. The reusable paired driver adds accurate opaque-photograph metadata and an explicit16-operation batch, preserving the prior driver in earlier evidence. Production/harness/native/selector inputs stay immutable during all measurements.
invalidation: Ordinary Apply is also used for trellis chroma/Walsh and distortion-only mode selection: all eight displayed VP8 encode costs are refreshed once. Other affected VP8 H boundaries remain historical. VP8L lossless encoding, PNG/JPEG, decoders, resizing and text/drawing retain unchanged-path evidence. Earlier whole-execution profile shares predate this quantization change; unchanged-method source/JIT observations remain attributable.
